column1: # FROZEN synthetic fixture for capability/selftest.py (#14 review, should-fix #2:
# fleet/scratch/ticket-assign-review.md Q4a). Hand-designed, NOT derived from the
# live fleet/model-scorecard.tsv (which is append-only and was mid-benchmark-run
# when this was written) — do not append live rows here; this file's whole point
# is to stay stable while the live scorecard keeps growing.
# Same 13-column shape ScorecardGradesProvider._load() parses:
#   date  source  ref  work_class  tier  model  verdict  gate  score  time_s  cost_usd  corrections  note
# Model ids reuse real charon/src/charon/model_catalog.py entries (glm-5.2=med,
# claude-opus-4-8=high, claude-haiku-4.5=low, claude-sonnet-5=med, gpt-5.5=high,
# kimi-k2.6=med) on purpose, so get_tier_hint() resolves real tiers and the
# tier-exclusion path is exercisable without faking the catalog. hy3-preview-or
# is deliberately NOT in the catalog (tier_hint=None), matching the real
# benchmark-only-id gap get_tier_hint()'s docstring calls out.
# Coverage designed in:
#   - routing: glm-5.2 n=3 (2 MERGE + 1 real BLOCK) vs kimi-k2.6 n=1 lucky MERGE
#     -> the small-N-over-trust inversion case (must-fix #1).
#   - ci-infra: exactly one clean-MERGE model among FIXES competitors.
#   - money-path: hy3-preview-or is the only BLOCK verdict.
#   - refactor / bugfix: independent distinct winners (differentiation proof).
#   - frontend: claude-opus-4-8 + glm-5.2 have DIRECT data; claude-sonnet-5 does
#     not (its only data is under "tests") -> generalist-fallback-vs-direct
#     de-prioritization case (should-fix #3).
#   - tests: claude-sonnet-5 n=5 (4 MERGE + 1 FIXES) -> a high-n, NOT
#     LOW_CONFIDENCE case, for contrast against the n=1/n=3 low-n cases above.
#   - greenfield-feature: intentionally NO rows for anyone -> pure
#     generalist-fallback path (should-fix #2's fallback coverage ask).
